topic:
Built-in weapon passives apply to a Skill Card only when compatibility is established through the passive’s declared Compatible Skill Tags (tags only - REVISED 2026-10-26 USER RULING: Target Rules are no longer used for compatibility).

After compatibility is established, the passive resolves according to its declared delivery rule.

Delivery may be:
- Once per Skill action
- Once per affected target
- Once per successful hit

Reduced Pattern damage does not reduce passive magnitude unless the passive explicitly scales from damage dealt.

Multi-hit and multi-target Skills repeat a passive only when the passive’s declared delivery rule permits repetition.

Weapon RT Delay applies to a Skill Card only when that Skill explicitly declares Weapon RT Delay Inheritance. Weapon RT Delay is not automatically delivered by every Skill Card.

topic:
Skill Cards are level-less authored active abilities. Each Skill explicitly declares effect tags, Target Rules, costs, formulas, weapon-property inheritance, Bonus Skill Range inheritance, eligible weapon passives, projectile behavior, pattern behavior, Skill Potency eligibility, and special rules.

Skill Potency Multiplier = 1 + INT / (200 + INT).

Skill Potency Bonus = Skill Potency Multiplier - 1.

Every Skill Card explicitly declares whether Skill Potency applies and identifies the damage, healing, shield, or other approved formula component it modifies.

Skill Potency does not apply to a Skill formula unless the Skill explicitly declares it.

No separate Spell Power stat exists.

section: Max MP and Bonus Skill Range
topic:
Max MP = 20 + INT x 2.

Bonus Skill Range = floor(INT / 75) + Flat Skill Range Bonuses.

Every Skill Card explicitly declares its Skill Range Inheritance percentage.

Default Skill Range Inheritance is 100%.

Inherited Bonus Skill Range = round(Bonus Skill Range × Skill Range Inheritance).

Flat Skill Range bonuses apply even when INT has not reached the next 75-point threshold.

Bonus Skill Range changes targeting distance only.

Bonus Skill Range does not automatically enlarge Pattern dimensions, AOE dimensions, splash size, Line length, Cone size, Chain-jump distance, or any other area dimension unless the Skill explicitly says otherwise.

Use the Manual’s global rounding rule where .5 rounds up.
